body:
Design-only request636b1603-fdb3-4e38-a002-4c69476be539 complete for review. Published origin/codex/save-destination-intent-design atf426c9de; single docs-only commit above5ebeb17a. Read main737dcd09 docs/coordination/SAVE-DESTINATION-RACE-PLAN.md and actual native/backend/stub/UI paths. File tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/SAVE-DESTINATION-INTENT-DESIGN.md. Adapter93244f8f and all product/tests untouched; no B builds/tests/apps/benchmarks/heartbeat restart.

Concrete additive proposal: DocumentSession.save_as_checked(path,intent)->Result<DocumentSaveAsResult{Saved,DestinationExists}>; Swift checked saveAs(path:intent:)->DocSaveAsResult alongside unchanged legacy path-only method. Two explicit intents CreateIfAbsent / ReplaceConfirmed. Global BridgeError stays unchanged; no string parsing. UI absent Save latches create intent; only actual matching Replace affirmative response gives replacement intent, still gated by owned native drain. Confirmed replacement keeps destination-path overwrite semantics even if external bytes change afterward; no universal identity CAS, no disabled Replace. Typed conflict flows through actual writer completion and preparation outcome; no Saved/folder/path/title/saved-node/map advance or close continuation.

Native plan unifies DocumentSession native/PSD/PSB bytes through unique staged commit; uses public compositor::format::to_bytes to bypass fixed native temp filename without changing format. Ordinary save/legacy methods remain replacement; copy-only cancellation APIs unchanged. Precise ownership/file map, generated binding paths/build-script checkpoint and tiny deterministic commit-race/concurrent-writer/unsafe-entry/Replace/control/UI tests included. Stub needs real atomic helper plus captured snapshot head/save ordering rather than current post-I/O current-head assignment.

Review decision called out: pinned tempfile3.27.0 Unix persist_noclobber fallback hard_link then unlink IGNORES unlink failure. Do not claim guaranteed staging cleanup from returned success. Design recommends explicit std::fs::hard_link with retained unique NamedTempFile owner for CreateIfAbsent on supported local macOS filesystems, then checked stage.close; unsupported FS fails closed. A native owner must approve this choice or specify equally explicit persist_noclobber cleanup policy. Post-publication cleanup failure is committed Saved plus cleanup diagnostic, never false conflict/untouched-destination failure; tests preserve cleanup evidence. No runtime guarantee established. A owns implementation authorization/native/compiler/main; B hold intact.
